system.description:
With the barest effort you gaze across the Shroud, and the Underworld unfolds before you as a decaying, ghastly reflection of the living world.

Expend a Mental Trait to look across the Shroud for the duration of the scene or for one hour, whichever comes first. You can see (though not hear or feel) anything transpiring in the Underworld within your normal visual range, using a kind of double sight that does not hinder your ordinary vision.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
